source.name: Community Berger 338 Caliber 250 Grain Hybrid OTM Tactical

loads.notes: Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Michelle Gallagher; Posted: Apr 3, 2012; 250gr Berger. She posted another tester's writeup. Dakota Arms 338 Lapua Mag. Third firing on Lapua brass. The 3.820 figure is a PTG comparator ogive length, not COAL. Day 1 fired 85.0 gr and half-grain steps toward 86.5 and gave three group sizes without assigning each size to a charge. The 86.2 gr RL 22 load in the same post is a 300 gr bullet.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: GNERGY; Posted: Mar 16, 2012; 250gr Hybrid OTM Tactical. Sighter group at 560 yards. The same-night post named Fed 215 Mag primers for this 7828SSC test and said he also loaded from 87 gr to 90 gr in half-grain steps, seated .050 off, without posting each step.
